issues.description: The verification-statistics CI job disables Verus bootstrap but then builds line_count from the untracked tools/verus source tree, so a clean runner has no Cargo manifest to build.
issues.rationale: On a fresh checkout tools/verus is gitignored and absent. The setup action conditions both cache restore and bootstrap on inputs.verus == true; the job passes false. The separate line_count cache restores only source/target, not source/Cargo.toml. cargo build --manifest-path tools/verus/source/Cargo.toml therefore fails before producing stats. The next commit changes the job to verus:true, enabling source restoration/bootstrap. This is a PR-internal direct parent/child repair, not inferred from commit title alone.
issues.source_evidence:
.github/workflows/ci.yml
296:       - name: Set up toolchain and caches
297:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-verus
298:         with:
299:           verus: 'false'
300:           dv-cache: 'restore'
301: 
302:       - name: Cache line_count build
303:         uses: actions/cache@v6
304:         with:
305:           path: tools/verus/source/target
306:           key: ${{ runner.os }}-line-count-${{ hashFiles('tools/verus/source/Cargo.lock', 'tools/verus/source/tools/line_count/**') }}
307:           restore-keys: |
308:             ${{ runner.os }}-line-count-
309: 
310:       - name: Build line_count
311:         run: cargo build --release -p line_count --manifest-path tools/verus/source/Cargo.toml
issues.verification: source-only; historical CI and Verus not executed. Checked complete job and composite-action branches, gitignored and absent tools/verus tree, exact parent/child patch, archived PR patch membership; issue_comments and review_comments arrays are empty.
